fact: Airtel Malawi says it has increased its international connectivity from three to five fibre routes, including new links through Tanzania and through Mozambique via Nacala.
Airtel Malawi says it currently has international data fibre links, a main link from Mozambique and two backup links from Zambia, Malawi being landlocked.

TNM says it acquired additional fibre routes into Malawi via Zambia (Mchinji/Chipata, from ZESCO/Telecom Namibia and MTN Zambia) and Mozambique (Muloza/Mulanje, from TMCel) after subsea cable cuts left it only the Mchinji/Chipata link.
